subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Do both the primary and fallback GitHub App installations intentionally grant repository Contents: Read, so these workflows may require that permission during token creation?
rationale: Only the App installation owners can verify and authorize the external permission grant; source review and a successful earlier workflow run cannot prove that both production token-minting paths retain that grant.

options.title: Verify both App installations and merge
options.body: Confirm both installed Apps grant Contents: Read and accept the explicit least-privilege workflow contract.

options.title: Keep the current token contract
options.body: Do not merge until the workflow can meet its repository-read need without requiring Contents: Read from either App installation.

options.title: Pause for automation ownership review
options.body: Hold the PR if the intended App permissions or fallback behavior are not currently documented or owned.

recommendation.title: Verify both App installations and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm both installed Apps grant Contents: Read and accept the explicit least-privilege workflow contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for the repository-level automation and GitHub App permission decision.
